scope: R1 status/stop slice: framed read-only supervisor status, explicit authenticated stop, a headless lapis supervisor binary, replay-safe state reading, focused tests, and launcher discovery for the pinned worktree gate. No reset, GUI birth route, launchd, package, reboot, workload, or runtime launch behavior is added.

implementation.protocol: Birth and control replies now use the same four-byte big-endian bounded frame as requests. Status requires an exact version/action object. A frame with trailing bytes is closed instead of processed, and every control peer has a five-second deadline so a malformed or abandoned client cannot hold a slot or stall the daemon loop. Reply writes retry a bounded nonblocking socket and drop the peer instead of throwing out of the loop.
implementation.status: Reports schema version, instance epoch, empty/started/stopped slot, enabled state, live-service flag, blocked reason, endpoint only while live, and reconstructability. It never reports the spawn token, launch payload, environment, argument list, or ownership file.
implementation.stop: Stop reads only the private regular owner-only version-two state file without acquiring the daemon lock, then sends its epoch and spawn token once. A version-one or unreadable slot, or a stale state refused by the authoritative registry, never retries.
implementation.client: The opt-in lapis_supervisor target emits lapis and accepts status or stop with --control-endpoint, --state-directory, and --json. Stop requires --state-directory and returns nonzero for rejection.
implementation.launch_environment: The launcher resolves linked-worktree Ghostty and pinned Qt from the primary checkout, compares local and shared prefixes by receipt time, exposes supervisor-runtime for the focused gate, and exposes supervisor for the built client. The Apple network-information plugin deployment is guarded on target availability so non-Apple or pluginless Qt builds still configure.

validation.name: focused-supervisor-client-gate
validation.result: Configure, targeted build, all focused CTest suites, real-service integration, daemon integration, and client integration passed. The receipt records six checks with aggregate passed=true.

validation.name: live-empty-client-probe
validation.result: The client connected and returned JSON with slot=empty, service_live=false, endpoint=null, and no token.

validation.name: shared-static-gate
validation.result: Dev configure/build/CTest, clang-format, Cppcheck and all clang-tidy workers passed.

validation.name: focused-asan-ubsan
validation.command: cmake --preset r1-runtime -B build/r1-runtime-asan -DLAPIS_SANITIZER=address; build targets; ctest -R '^supervisor-(state|runtime|session-service|client|daemon)$'
validation.result: All five focused supervisor suites passed under AddressSanitizer/UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer.

validation.name: focused-tsan
validation.command: cmake --preset r1-runtime -B build/r1-runtime-tsan -DLAPIS_SANITIZER=thread; build targets; ctest -R '^supervisor-(state|runtime|session-service|client|daemon)$'
validation.result: A first full run failed once on a synchronization deadline without a race report; the repaired build then passed all five focused suites under ThreadSanitizer.

validation.name: repository-contracts
validation.command: python3 scripts/check_markdown_links.py; jq -e evidence/r1-supervisor-client-20261017.json; git diff --check HEAD; diff privacy scan
validation.result: Markdown links and fragments resolve, the durable receipt parses as JSON, git diff --check reports no whitespace errors, and the diff privacy scan found no absolute path, address, token, or private-key pattern.

failed_attempts.attempt: standalone focused configure in the linked worktree
failed_attempts.result: The build selected Homebrew Qt 6.12.0 and rejected the exact Qt 6.11.2 requirement.
failed_attempts.repair: The launcher now discovers the shared primary checkout's pinned Qt and Ghostty build, and exposes supervisor-runtime.

failed_attempts.result: The client rejected the birth/control reply as outside its bound because the server sent JSON without the existing four-byte request frame.
failed_attempts.repair: The control server now frames every reply with the same header contract and handles nonblocking writes without escaping the daemon loop.

failed_attempts.attempt: directly linking the Qt network-information plugin
failed_attempts.result: macOS rejected the MH_BUNDLE plugin as a linker input.
failed_attempts.repair: On Apple, build post-processing deploys the plugin beside lapis with qt.conf; Linux needs no Apple plugin.

failed_attempts.attempt: QLocalSocket inside the in-process client unit test
failed_attempts.result: The test aborted before completing the framed round trip.
failed_attempts.repair: Kept codec/security/state coverage in the unit suite and covered real QLocalSocket transport through the independent daemon/CLI integration.

failed_attempts.result: The real daemon test missed its first synchronization assertion once; no data-race report was emitted.
failed_attempts.repair: The daemon test passed three consecutive repeats and a complete second focused TSan run passed all five suites.

non_claims: This is not a production birth client: the GUI still owns direct detached launches, and the supervisor verb only observes or explicitly stops the opt-in daemon.
No operator reset protocol is implemented; incompatible v1 and failed-birth slots still require a reviewed stop-or-leave disposition.
No launchd registration, package inclusion, update transition, GUI replacement qualification, reboot recovery, credential environment admission, or workload/load claim is made.
The harmless /bin/cat child proves process and v6 ownership, not Codex or Claude adapter behavior.
The focused gate runs on macOS; Linux build or supervisor qualification remains separate.

review_repairs.finding: Malformed frames with trailing bytes or an abandoned peer could hold every control slot.
review_repairs.repair: The control server closes over-long frames, applies a five-second per-client deadline, and the daemon test now proves four idle peers release their slots.

review_repairs.finding: Nonblocking reply writes could retry forever inside the daemon loop.
review_repairs.repair: Writes poll for writability with a bounded deadline and drop the peer instead of throwing.

review_repairs.finding: Stop state reading accepted version-one state although the receipt and status claim v2-only.
review_repairs.repair: read_control_state now requires version 2 and the client test proves version-one refusal.

review_repairs.finding: The client-integration marker matched both the unit and integration suites.
review_repairs.repair: The unit suite prints supervisor-client-unit: ok; the gate requires the daemon test's supervisor-client-integration: ok.

review_repairs.finding: The client unit suite hardcoded macOS-only temporary paths.
review_repairs.repair: Fixture state no longer depends on /private/tmp, so the same test configures on Linux.

review_repairs.finding: The Apple network-information plugin was referenced unconditionally.
review_repairs.repair: Deployment and qt.conf now depend on the plugin target existing.

review_repairs.finding: The initial receipt omitted later test edits and several changed documentation/build files, leaving stale digests.
review_repairs.repair: The final receipt binds all seventeen changed non-receipt files by SHA-256 and was verified with a mechanical digest comparison.

review_repairs.finding: status --json printed unvalidated replies, so scripts could not trust the exit code.
review_repairs.repair: print_status decodes and validates every reply before printing, in both output modes.

review_repairs.finding: The framed round-trip unit test polled the control server exactly once.
review_repairs.repair: The test now polls until the reply is read or a bounded deadline expires, and joins the thread on success and failure.

review_repairs.finding: The trailing-byte daemon test depended on stream-socket write boundaries.
review_repairs.repair: That assertion was removed; the oversized header and slot-timeout guards now prove the malformed-frame and abandoned-peer paths deterministically.

review_repairs.finding: Two validation result strings described the wrong command.
review_repairs.repair: focused-tsan records the ThreadSanitizer outcome and repository-contracts records its own link, JSON, whitespace, and privacy results.
